verdict.rationale: A state business-filing and records portal could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data. The Business Licensing Wizard is a guided form that returns agency lists and tips, and Live Chat is a support channel; neither is evidenced as AI analyzing the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
